paths.name: Path 1: Immediate Sale & Diversified Equity Reinvestment
paths.summary: Sell Property A in the year of trust transfer under IRC §1014 stepped-up basis (near-zero capital gains), pay ~5.6% brokerage + SCC transfer/recording fees, invest net proceeds in a low-cost diversified equity/bond portfolio, and keep living in Property B Unit 3.

paths.name: Path 2: Hold & Rent Property A (Full Prop 19 Reassessment)
paths.summary: Keep living in Property B Unit 3 and lease Property A at Cupertino market rent. Because the heir does not occupy Property A as primary residence within 1 year, Prop 19 fails and Property A reassesses to 100% FMV (~1.171% + direct fees). Uses 27.5-year MACRS depreciation on ~40% building value; exposed to post-NEM 2.0 solar bills, CapEx, and §1250 recapture if ever sold.

paths.name: Path 3: Move Into Property A & Claim Prop 19 + Rent Property B Unit 3
paths.summary: Occupy Property A within 1 year as long-term principal residence, file BOE-19-P to preserve FBYV + indexed Prop 19 allowance (~$1.045M today, indexed forward), and lease out Property B's 3rd unit (market initial rent under Costa-Hawkins, then SF Rent Ordinance 1.6%/yr cap if pre-1979). Includes explicit imputed-rent housing value for Property A.
paths.omiRisk: High if ever moving back to B3 (SF Prop H OMI ~$8.25k–$24.7k/unit; blocked for elderly/disabled long-term tenants)

paths.name: Path 4: Live in Property A (5 Yrs w/ Prop 19 + §121), Then Sell & Return/Invest
paths.summary: Move into Property A for 5 years (securing Prop 19 savings while renting Property B Unit 3), then sell Property A claiming IRC §121 ($250k/$500k tax-free gain above §1014 basis). Accounts for brokerage/transfer costs, SF Prop H OMI relocation risk to recover Property B Unit 3, and reinvesting net sale proceeds.
paths.omiRisk: Material — reclaiming Property B Unit 3 after 5 yrs triggers OMI rules & relocation fees

paths.name: Path 5: Sell Property A at Transfer + 24–36 Mo Treasury Staging Into Equities
paths.summary: Sell Property A at §1014 step-up and park net proceeds in 3M T-Bills or a 2Y Treasury Ladder (currently 4.34% (3M) to 4.61% (2Y), Treasury par curve, Nov 25, 2026) while phasing into diversified stocks over 24–36 months. Softens 1929/2008 entry crashes while explicitly quantifying Reinvestment Risk (yield drop during Fed cuts) and Opportunity Drag in bull markets.

paths.name: Path 6: Rent Property A 5 Yrs + IRC §1031 Exchange Into Higher-Yield Assets
paths.summary: Operate Property A as a full-reassessment rental for 5 years (capturing 27.5-yr depreciation), then execute an IRC §1031 tax-deferred exchange (45-day ID / 180-day close; FTB Form 3840 if out of state) into a higher-cap-rate diversified income portfolio (~4.8% net yield vs ~2.0% Cupertino net cap rate).

blackSwanRegimes.name: Realistic Non-Constant 50-Yr Baseline (Cycle-Varying Growth & Inflation)
blackSwanRegimes.description: Models alternating 7–10 yr expansions, recessions, and sticky inflation regimes instead of straight-line growth. Mean ~7.2% nominal equity, ~3.4% Bay Area RE, ~2.8% CPI-U, ~4.0% short Treasuries.

blackSwanRegimes.name: 1929–1939 Great Depression Entry Shock
blackSwanRegimes.description: Severe equity collapse in Years 1–3 (-45%, -28%, -35% nominal path) followed by deflationary/slow recovery; Bay Area RE drops -28% over 4 yrs; short Treasury rates collapse from 4.3% to 0.3% (acute 3M T-bill reinvestment risk!).
blackSwanRegimes.shockSummary: -80% peak equity drawdown; T-bill yields drop near 0%

blackSwanRegimes.name: 1973–1982 Stagflation & Rate Shock (BLS CPI; 14.8% peak, 7.3% average UNVERIFIED)
blackSwanRegimes.description: Two inflation waves (1974 +11% & 1979–80 +13.3%–14.8% CPI), -38% real stock drop in Yrs 1–2, surging insurance/maintenance/CapEx costs (+9%/yr) while SF rent control caps existing tenancies at 1.6%–3%!
blackSwanRegimes.shockSummary: High CPI erodes real bond returns & squeezes rent-controlled cash flow

blackSwanRegimes.name: 2000–2009 Double Crash & 2008 GFC Entry
blackSwanRegimes.description: Repeated equity drawdowns (Yr 1–2 -38%, Yr 6 -37%) combined with Bay Area housing correction (-22%) and zero-interest-rate policy cutting 3M T-bill rolls from 4.8% down to 0.15% (severe reinvestment risk!).
blackSwanRegimes.shockSummary: Lost-decade equity volatility + 22% RE drop + 0.15% T-bill cliff

blackSwanRegimes.name: 2020 V-Crash + 2022 Inflation/Duration Shock
blackSwanRegimes.description: Year 1 sharp -34% V-drop reversing +48% within 12 months (testing staging opportunity drag!), followed in Year 3 by +9.1% CPI and -19% equities / -13% long bonds simultaneously.
blackSwanRegimes.shockSummary: Fast V-rebound creates high staging lag + simultaneous 2022 stock/bond hit

missingInfoQuestions.question: What is the estimated total gross estate (liquid securities, retirement accounts, business interests, Property A, life insurance) and are there prior Form 709 taxable gifts?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Determines whether estate clears the 2026 $15M / $30M married federal exclusion or faces a 40% estate tax due 9 months post-death—requiring an Estate Liquidity Plan or §6166/borrowing.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Review latest family trust schedules, brokerage year-end statements, and CPA Form 709 records offline; enter only $10k-rounded buckets into local sliders.

missingInfoQuestions.question: Is the trust a single survivor's trust, revocable living trust, or split A/B bypass trust? Did a predeceased spouse leave unused DSUE portability on Form 706?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Bypass (B) trust assets may NOT receive a second IRC §1014 step-up in basis at the surviving spouse's death, completely flipping Sell-vs-Hold capital gains math.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Have estate attorney inspect trust agreement and verify whether Form 706 portability election was timely filed (or qualifies under 5-yr Rev. Proc. 2022-32).

missingInfoQuestions.category: Property A Exact TRA & Direct Parcel Taxes
missingInfoQuestions.question: What is Property A's exact 6-digit Santa Clara County Tax Rate Area (013-xxx) and itemized direct parcel assessments on the 2025–2026 / 2026–2027 tax bill?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Cupertino TRA rate is UNVERIFIED in this session (1% levy and SCVWD 0.0039% verified); exact rate plus bonds and parcel charges must be read from the parcel bill.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Look up the secured bill via Santa Clara County DTAC portal locally using APN (never paste APN or PDF into GitHub).

missingInfoQuestions.category: Property A Specs, Solar & CapEx Age
missingInfoQuestions.question: What are Property A's exact beds/baths/sqft/lot size, land-vs-improvement assessor split, roof/HVAC/plumbing age, and solar NEM 2.0 interconnection date?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Land share sets 27.5-yr depreciation deduction; exact beds/sqft tighten Cupertino rental comps ($5.0k vs $8.0k/mo); solar PTO date sets when the 20-year NEM 2.0 legacy ends.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Check original PG&E PTO email, building permit history on Cupertino city portal, and Santa Clara County Assessor notice.

missingInfoQuestions.category: Property B Rent Control, SqFt & Tenants
missingInfoQuestions.question: Was Property B built before June 13, 1979? What is its total building square footage? Do current tenants hold protected status (60+/disabled 10+ yrs, or SFUSD family)?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Pre-1979 status locks 1.6% SF Rent Board caps & bans OMI on protected tenants; total >5,000 sqft triggers extra $0.195/sqft under Nov 2026 SF Prop H starting July 1, 2027.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Check Property B Certificate of Occupancy / DBI permit record and existing written leases offline with SF landlord counsel.

missingInfoQuestions.question: What are actual 2026 renewal quotes for homeowners/landlord liability + umbrella + earthquake (CEA) policies on Property A and 3-unit habitational coverage on Property B?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: The $1,500/yr figure is an unverified owner placeholder. The model uses analyst sensitivity bands ($2.8k–$6.5k for A; $4.8k–$10.5k for B) that are NOT sourced quotes; obtain broker quotes before relying on them.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Obtain 2 independent broker quotes (admitted carrier + FAIR Plan/DIC fallback) for both personal residence and landlord forms.

missingInfoQuestions.question: What is the heir's expected marginal AGI/MAGI at transfer (triggering 3.8% NIIT >$200k/$250k and CA +1% surtax >$1M) and genuine 5–10+ yr willingness to live in Cupertino?
missingInfoQuestions.whyItMatters: Prop 19 exclusion is lost immediately if the heir moves out; Form 540 combined 13.3% rate heavily penalizes non-sheltered capital gains or depreciation recapture.
missingInfoQuestions.howToDiscoverPrivately: Run private Form 1040 / Form 540 projections with CPA and formalize the written Pre-Commitment Decision Criteria.
